decision.reasoning_trace: I narrowed the search down to products that offered a balance of high wattage, positive user feedback, and value for money. I excluded several items in the feed that were merely accessories (cases, chargers). Within my consideration set, the Harman Kardon (116) was high quality but expensive, while the JBL Flip 5 (001) carried the risk associated with being a renewed product. The BOGASING M4 (174) stood out as the best overall choice because it offered 40W of stereo sound, an IPX7 waterproof rating, and a long battery life for a mid-range price, supported by strong verified purchase reviews.
